name: Lana Marie Loud
source:
Lana is the twin sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c151347]Lola[/url], though she was born first making her technically the elder twin! I could describe Lana as the opposite of her twin Lola, where as Lola is the queen of girly, Lana is the most tomboyish of all my sisters!

Lana loves getting her hands dirty, whether it's working on cars, fixing the plumbing in our house, or taking care of her many many pets. That's probably the most ‘girlish' part of her, the love of animals she has, and the way she's able to train them.

Lana hasn't met an animal or insect she wasn't able to train or take care of. Her frog hops is her number one companion. The two of them are often found rooting through the trash, checking out the junkyard, or swamps, and playing in the mud together.

Lana will literally eat anything you give to her, and will try anything once. Her nickname as the ‘queen of risks' is well rewarded. She even likes to wrestle alligators (and often uses me for practice!).

Lana though is a total sweetheart though and loves helping others. Her best friend is her twin Lola, and the two of them even have their own twin language. One of the girl's favorite things to do is load up in Lola's pink jeep and start acting like cops, ready to arrest anyone for whatever misdeed they've decided on that day!

[In game description]
